name: What colors are popular for bathrooms right now?

mainEntity.name: What colors are popular for bathrooms right now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current popular bathroom colors often lean towards serene and clean aesthetics. Shades of white, light gray, and soft blues and greens are consistently favored for their ability to create a spa-like, calming atmosphere. Earthy tones and warm neutrals are also gaining popularity, bringing a natural and inviting feel. Bold accents with deeper blues, charcoal, or even black can be used on a single wall or cabinetry for a modern touch. Ultimately, the best color complements your home's overall style and your personal preference. City Dweller, LLC can offer color consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular bathroom colors include serene whites, light grays, soft blues, greens, and warm neutrals, with bolder accents for modern touches.
